speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Thou art down late. The house has been at it this hour.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Thy feet are a disgrace to the family, brother.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The bread is cut. Sit when thou hast it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They will take a basin later. They will not take a lecture before bread.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: I am not lecturing. I am telling thee what they look like on my floor.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the floor has seen them. Where is the bread?
